Market grades

A 6.5% · B 7% · C 8% QUALIFIES bar

A = growing (Johnson, Dubuque) · B = stable (Linn, Scott, Cedar, Jones, Washington, Iowa, Benton, Delaware) · C = flat/shrinking (Clinton, Black Hawk, Muscatine, Lee, Des Moines, Louisa, Jackson, Buchanan). Rehab cap $8k/$4k/$2k per door; known repairs over cap are flagged REHAB > CAP and the overage ×1.1 comes off the bid. 10-yr return = study model, conservative case (county 2005–15 home-price CAGR, NOI +1.5%/yr, +1.0% in C; 75% LTV 30-yr, 6% sale cost). (est.) = no county series pulled; tier average used. Moline (IL) graded B with Scott Co. data.
